## Fixes

- **A wide board can be scrolled sideways with a mouse** (#98, thanks @letelba). The board had no scrollbar, and its bottom edge sat below the window, so the columns past the right edge could only be reached with a trackpad. The board now ends inside the window and shows a quiet bar when its columns overflow, wherever there is a mouse. The collection toolbar wraps onto a second row instead of cutting off Filter, Sort and New when there are many views or the window is narrow.

## Fixes

- **Search finds pages for two or more words again** (#107, thanks @ymbroxe). As soon as one word of a search had a second spelling (a shortened stem, or ss for a sharp s), the query was one the search index refuses, and the refusal came back as "no results". Most searches of two words found nothing, German ones above all.
- **Line breaks in a text property survive a click** (#108, thanks @ymbroxe). Clicking into a value and leaving it saved the value without its line breaks, even without typing.

## Security fix

- **Read-only tokens and templates.** A read-only API token could save any page its account may write as a template over MCP (`save_as_template`): the tool was missing from the list of writing tools the token scope is checked against. That list now names the reading tools instead, so a tool missing from it is refused to a read-only token rather than let through, and a test runs every tool in the catalogue against a read-only token. # LinkBreeze v1.4.1

> **Live preview that actually follows your edits — plus autosave, image positioning, and a round of security fixes.**

---

## ✨ Admin experience

### 🔴 Live preview follows every edit
The preview pane used to lag one save behind — save, hit refresh, and *still* see the last-but-one state. Now:

- **Cache-busted reloads** (`?v=<timestamp>`) after every save, including the manual refresh button
- **One shared save flow** (`useSavedAction`) drives every admin form — profile, l

LinkBreeze 1.4.0

## Added

- **Two-factor authentication (TOTP)** — The admin login can now require a second factor: a 6-digit code from any authenticator app. Setup lives in Settings → Security: scan the QR or paste the secret, confirm with one live code, and save your 8 single-use recovery codes. Secrets are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); "trust this device for 30 days" skips the code step per browser, and re-enrolling invalidates every trust.
- **Popup link cards: text and location** — Two new li

LinkBreeze v1.3.2

## What's new

### Spanish admin UI (es)
The admin speaks a third language. A complete Spanish dictionary (700 keys, tuteo register, terminology aligned with the Spanish README) ships alongside English and French with the same compile-time key parity and drift guards — a missing key fails the build, not your users. Español joins the language picker in Settings; the choice persists per user like en/fr.

Also fixed along the way: four keys that had drifted and rendered as raw key paths (

The whole admin panel (dashboard, links, theme customizer, settings, migration wizard, setup, onboarding, profile, dialogs, toasts, error screens) now renders fully in French. A language picker in Settings switches instantly; the choice persists per user (cookie + database). English remains the default; public link pages stay English by design so shared URLs and SEO never shift with the admin language.

### Frutiger Aero theme
A glossy mid-2000s "water + air" theme — the 11th built-in preset:

- **Frosted glass everywhere** — semi-transparent cloud-white card tint, backdrop blur, thin light borders, soft sky glow.

- **Email capture consent (#75)** — Subscriber form now requires a consent checkbox. Consent timestamp and exact consent text stored in the database for audit trail. CSV export includes consent columns.
